generator.scope: Compact four-PMOS VCO v4 candidate, explicit SUB and NWell taps, external VCTRL and 2.3 V rail. No PLL/clock recovery, post-layout oscillation/fanout/current/RF qualification or complete PHY.

first_pilot.cause: Relocated stage escape lanes intersected old distributed SUB tap M4 routes. All12 finite taps moved to clear left corridor, identical contact dimensions and topology. MainDRC alone did not detect the conductor short.

first_checker.cause: Copied fault cut x335-355 while actual PMOS moved tox400. Native unchanged topology passed, so checker refused the negative. Corrected fault derives exact well bridge and native PMOS gap from source-pinned generated geometry.

scope: Native geometry of exact four-W8 PMOS VCOv4. Real well/body polygons with12 finite ptaps and one finite ntap. No artificial net union, foldedW32, ideal power boost or change to source circuit.
